translations.ko: 물은 열다섯 규빗 위로 불어나 산들을 덮었다.
translations.en: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
translations.es: Quince codos por encima subieron las aguas, y cubrieron los montes.

translations.ko: 땅 위에서 움직이는 모든 육체, 곧 새와 가축과 들짐승과 땅에 떼 지어 다니는 모든 것과 모든 사람이 죽었다.
translations.en: And all flesh died that moved on the earth, birds, livestock, wild animals, every swarming thing that swarms on the earth, and all humankind.
translations.es: Murió toda carne que se movía sobre la tierra: aves, ganados, animales salvajes, todo ser que pulula sobre la tierra, y todo ser humano.

verses.counterargument_ko: '모든 사람'을 성별 포괄로 볼지 단순 '인류'로 볼지는 번역 선택이다.

translations.en: Everything on dry land in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life died.
translations.es: Todo lo que tenía aliento de espíritu de vida en sus narices, todo lo que había en la tierra seca, murió.

translations.en: And the waters prevailed on the earth a hundred and fifty days.
translations.es: Y las aguas prevalecieron sobre la tierra ciento cincuenta días.
